description: In an expansion of an old structure, \(D_\rho\) is true exactly when the new relation agrees tuple by tuple with the old formula \(\rho\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.realize_definingAxiom.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Structure M]
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.oldInclusion.IsExpansionOn M] (ρ : L.Formula (Fin n)) :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.definingAxiom ρ ↔
    ∀ (a : Fin n → M), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.relationAtom.Realize a ↔ ρ.Realize a
